scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/memory-gateway install && npm --prefix apps/memory-console install
scripts.stop:local: screen -S agent-data-gateway -X quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; screen -S agent-data-console -X quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/memory-gateway run build && npm --prefix apps/memory-console run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/memory-gateway test && npm --prefix apps/memory-console test
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test
